i_mortar.lore.rare: Grinds peppercorns so hard that the whole kitchen sneezes in chorus.

toolbox.lore.common: Rattles all the way to the job, then turns out to be missing the one screwdriver needed.

x_cable.lore.common: Comes out of the drawer with three other cables, a hair clip and a key attached.
x_cable.lore.uncommon: Is exactly ten centimetres too short to reach from the socket to the bed.

x_chain.lore.common: Clanks against the bike frame on every bump in the road.

x_chisel.lore.uncommon: Gets borrowed as a paint-tin opener so often that its edge is covered in every colour.

x_whistle_small.lore.common: Is blown by every child who finds it, right next to someone's ear.

x_javelin.lore.uncommon: Is carried to the throwing line so carefully that everyone else steps well back.

x_usb_cable.lore.uncommon: Has a plug at one end that fits nothing in the house, and a plug at the other that fits everything.
x_usb_cable.lore.epic: Was pulled out by a passing dog, and three laptops, two phones and a lamp all went flying.

x_utility_knife.lore.uncommon: Clicks its blade back in so firmly that grown-ups nod at it approvingly.

x_vise.lore.uncommon: Pinches your fingertips when its handle is cranked too quickly.
